bullets.text: Satellite Services Approved - **Ofcom** greenlights direct-to-device satellite services for UK smartphones, enhancing connectivity in remote areas.
5G Protocol Testing Vital - Continuous **5G protocol testing** ensures seamless connectivity and prevents service disruptions in critical applications.
AI Revolutionizing Telecom - **AI** is set to drive significant growth in wireless and telecom sectors, enhancing connectivity and efficiency.
AI Phones Transforming Economics - The shift to **AI phones** promises to streamline user tasks and redefine mobile economics.
2026 Telecom Strategies - Focus on **edge AI**, data sovereignty, and monetisation will shape telecom operations in 2026.
Deutsche Telekom's AI Partnership - **OpenAI** collaborates with **Deutsche Telekom** to enhance network operations and customer service with AI.
AI-RAN Validation Achieved - **Samsung** and **KT** demonstrate successful AI-driven radio access network optimisation on live networks.
AI's Impact on Network Design - AI-driven workloads are reshaping **fibre** planning and network security strategies for 2026.
NTT DATA Expands Cyber Defense - Launching six new **AI-powered Cyber Defense Centers** to enhance cybersecurity resilience.
Private 5G Growth Accelerating - **Ericsson** highlights rapid adoption of private 5G, outpacing Wi-Fi in industrial applications.
